meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会当你的写作搭档：帮你搭大纲、查资料并添加引用、优化开头 Hook、逐段审阅给反馈，同时尽量保留你原本的语气和风格。
howto.when: 当你写博客、教程或技术文档，需要拟大纲、加引用或逐段反馈时，它会接管协作。

say.text: 帮我为这个主题写一篇文章的大纲
say.note: 它会先问受众、篇幅和写作目标

say.text: 这是我的开头，帮我把 Hook 改得更有吸引力
say.note: 它会给出现有分析和几种替代开头

say.text: 我刚写完「为什么重要」这一节，帮我审阅并给反馈
say.note: 会列优点、修改建议和具体改句

howto.what_en: Acts as your writing partner: helps build outlines, research topics and add citations, sharpen the hook, and give section-by-section feedback while keeping your own voice and tone.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, tutorials, or technical docs and you want help with outlining, citations, or per-section feedback.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about this topic
say_en.note: It asks about audience, length, and goal first.

say_en.text: Here's my intro - help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: It analyzes it and offers alternative openings.

say_en.text: I just finished the "Why This Matters" section. Review it.
say_en.note: You get strengths, fixes, and line edits.
